author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
body: DetectNullPropagatingNodes currently treats all binary operators except AndAlso/OrElse as null-propagating. This includes ExpressionType.Coalesce, which is not null-propagating (e.g., COALESCE(a, '') can be non-null even when a is null). That can cause DropNotNullChecks to incorrectly remove a IS NOT NULL predicates and change query semantics. Handle ExpressionType.Coalesce explicitly (do not treat its left operand as null-propagating), and consider auditing any other non-null-propagating binary operators represented as SqlBinaryExpression.
